annotations.title: US economy: inflation, jobs, Treasury yields and public debt (BLS, US Treasury)

description: Use for the US economy: US inflation (CPI), the US jobs report, US unemployment, real wages in the USA, US Treasury yields and an inverted yield curve, and US national debt. For Polish data, use get_macro_indicator. For other countries, use get_world_comparison. US economy from official US sources. topic inflation: CPI y/y and m/m and core CPI (BLS) with Polish CPI (GUS) for the same month. topic labor: BLS jobs report, change of nonfarm payrolls, unemployment rate, average hourly earnings and Realne płace w USA finwire (finwire_us_real_wage_growth, wage growth minus CPI, pp). topic yields: US Treasury par yield curve now and a year earlier, 10Y-2Y and 10Y-3M spreads, days with an inverted curve in the last 365 days. topic debt: US public debt (Debt to the Penny) and Licznik długu USA finwire (finwire_us_debt_per_second, debt growth per second in USD and PLN at the NBP mid rate). Default all topics. Each value has its period. No forecasts.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary of one topic, default 6; ignored for all.
